sentences.en: You need to reverse your vest, it's back to front.
sentences.zh: 你需要把背心反过来穿，现在是反了。

sentences.en: I need to bring this suede vest to the dry-cleaner's.
sentences.zh: 我得把这个麂皮背心送到干洗店去。

sentences.en: Any good negotiator plays his cards close to the vest.
sentences.zh: 任何好的谈判者都会对自己的底牌守口如瓶。
